scope: Persistent cooler-layer assembly, disassembly and return; the full paper campaign has additional preparation, manipulation and branch obligations.

robot.arm: Pinned Menagerie Panda joints, geometry, inertias and actuator limits
robot.gripper: Original 80 mm stroke and +/-40 N actuator limit; task-authored extended edge tips with 10 g added mass per finger
robot.control: Joint-actuated arm; gripper position control for approach/release and bounded force control for holding; no payload weld or live pose writes
robot.state_access: Privileged simulator object/force observations; no camera-perception validation

source_geometry.visual_meshes: Original cooling_scene_assets_v2 GLB parts with preserved vertices and part IDs
source_geometry.collisions: Open segmented tube/ring collisions; native structural meshes; no convex hull closes a working aperture
source_geometry.frame: Source reconstruction of acrylic base, rails, lift platform and hollow rods, pre-fixtured to the workbench
source_geometry.remaining: Exact historical extrusion profile, fixture details, film attachment method and PE support height were not provided by the paper

authored_fixtures: Raised emitter regrasp support for changing from the foam-clearing edge grasp to a centered transport grasp
Visible 6.4 mm shield-height shims and alignment pins

shield_height_resolution.reason: The earlier authored 57 mm PE tube plus 6.4 mm spacer was combined with a 57 mm shield whose bottom floated above the support. Explicit shims supply that missing load path. The paper does not specify PE tube height.

mass_basis.foam: Selected 25 kg/m3 XPS core at source dimensions plus wrap allowance; not a measured historical sample. Replaces the 20 g stress-test proxy in the separate legacy assembly fixture.
mass_basis.metals_and_pe: Nominal material densities and authored source-size geometry; aperture thickness and PE support height are reconstruction assumptions.

foam_primary_reference.verified_property: FOAMULAR 150 minimum compressive strength 15 psi (103 kPa), ASTM D1621

validation_limits: Rigid foam contact does not certify damage or compression
No paint damage, coating process, thermal or optical prediction
Every part must remain in its actual pose across steps; later operations recheck retained layers
Unintended loaded arm contacts are rejected even at shallow penetration; force audit sampled every 10 physics steps
Partial component or fixture success grants no automatic whole-paper step or branch credit
membrane_module: membrane.py and membrane_tests.json specify separate constrained-cloth load tests; robot handling integration is still under test
